title: 社團博覽會
question:
社團博覽會有很多場體驗活動，時間重疊的不能同時參加（一場結束的時間剛好是下一場開始也可以）。你想參加越多場越好。
請先輸入有幾場，再依序輸入每場的開始和結束時間（已經照結束時間由早到晚排好）。輸出最多可以參加幾場。
想想看：如果改成每次挑「最早開始」的，還會是最多場嗎？

test_case.note: 第 3 場結束 13 點，第 4 場 13 點開始，可以接著參加
三場都重疊，只能選一場

en.title: Club Fair
en.question:
The club fair has many activities. You cannot join two at the same time (one may start right when another ends). You want to join as many as you can.
First input the number of activities. Then input each start and end time (already sorted by end time). Output the most activities you can join.
Think: What if you always pick the one that starts earliest instead? Is that still the most?

test_case.note: No. 3 ends at 13 and no. 4 starts at 13: OK
All three clash, so only one
